items.title: Hackers exploited Zimbra flaw as zero-day using iCalendar files
items.description: Researchers monitoring for larger .ICS calendar attachments found that a flaw in Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) was used in zero-day attacks at the beginning of the year. [...]

items.title: ParkMobile pays... $1 each for 2021 data breach that hit 22 million
items.description: ParkMobile has finally wrapped up a class action lawsuit over the platform's 2021 data breach that hit 22 million users. But there's a catch: victims are receiving compensation in the form of a $1 in-app credit, which they must claim manually. And, it comes with an expiration date. [...]
